## Threnn-of-Second-Bloom Medium, humanoid (half-elf), chaotic neutral ![](images/0.jpg) Threnn-of-Second-Bloom is a half-elf from the Branchbound lineage, marked by their canopy-born heritage. With a slim frame and bark-like scar tissue, they embody the forest's impermanence while struggling to let go of attachments. Threnn's reflective amber eyes and moss-dyed leathers blend them seamlessly into their woodland home, but their refusal to move on from the overdue-to-be-abandoned Second Bloom has marked them as a defector. Though they are quiet and observant, their commitment to protection and discomfort with authority make them a complex figure, driven by a fear of unfinished business rather than mortality itself.
